steps.title: Audit Crash Logs and Project Structure

steps.title: Fix MainActivity Handler Threading
steps.description: Migrate deprecated empty Handler constructor to utilize the explicit Main Looper to prevent startup initialization exceptions on modern Android versions.

steps.title: Strip External Prohibited Dependencies

steps.title: Verify AndroidManifest.xml Integration
steps.description: Explicitly register package declaration attributes to validate namespace mapping on Gradle compilation tasks.

steps.title: Verify SQLite Database Operations
steps.description: Check column helpers and table structure statements to prevent runtime SQLiteExceptions.

steps.title: Inspect Resource Color and Drawables
steps.description: Review shape and gradient parameters inside button backgrounds and view borders.

steps.title: Verify SharedPreferences Operations
steps.description: Check preference persistency and operations flow across Activity lifecycles.

steps.description: Perform integrity mapping checks between widget UI identifiers and Java class control binds.

steps.description: Compile entire pipeline and execute safe debug build tests.
